set.description: 熟记 30°、45°、60° 的正弦、余弦、正切值，并会借助计算器求一般角的值。
set.name: Trigonometric Values of Special Angles and Calculations
set.nameZh: 特殊角的三角函数值与计算

criteria: 能计算 sin(α+β) 在特殊角上的值
能区分和角与差角公式的符号
set.description: 会用和角公式计算能化成 0、±1/2、±1 的值。
set.name: Sine and Cosine of the Sum of Two Angles

set.reason: Acute-angle complementarity is not in the side-length equation. It can usefully identify a right triangle when the angle is not given, supporting a restricted preparation link rather than the original hard claim. This acceptance is a new final mathematical judgment, not a mistaken activation from the prior native accept of Claude's rejection.
set.scope: Optionally identifying an unmarked right triangle from complementary acute angles

set.reason: Subsidiary triangle similarity proves height/median ratios; direct property use is a different route.
set.scope: proving ratios of heights, medians, bisectors

set.reason: Pythagoras is needed only when a missing side is calculated by that method.
set.scope: computing ratios when one side is missing

set.reason: Angle-independent ratios use proportional sides of similar right triangles.
set.scope: ratio depends only on angle

set.reason: Numerical solutions need special-value or calculator evaluation, both covered here.
set.scope: obtaining trig values to find elements

set.reason: Dividing sine and cosine formulas is the usual derivation. Applying tan(α−β) and checking the denominator only needs the tangent formula and tangent values.
set.scope: computing tan(α−β) and the denominator condition

criteria: 能选用恰当的三角函数
set.description: 已知直角三角形中的一些元素（至少一边），求出其余的边和角。
set.name: Solving Right Triangles

criteria: 能找出两个数全部公因数
set.description: 会求两个数的公因数和最大公因数。
set.name: Greatest common factor

criteria: 能写出三个比的表达式
理解其值只与角的大小有关
set.description: 在直角三角形中，锐角的正弦、余弦、正切分别是对边比斜边、邻边比斜边、对边比邻边。
set.name: Definitions of Trigonometric Functions of Acute Angles

criteria: 知道分母为 0 时公式不能用
set.description: 会用正切的和差公式计算分母不为 0 的特殊值。
set.name: Tangent of the Sum and Difference of Two Angles

criteria: 能由一个锐角求另一个锐角
能判断有两角互余的三角形形状
set.description: 直角三角形的两个锐角互余；有两个角互余的三角形是直角三角形。
set.name: The two acute angles of a right triangle are complementary
set.nameZh: 直角三角形的两个锐角互余

set.description: 直角三角形两直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方：a²+b²=c²。
set.name: Pythagorean theorem

set.description: 两角分别相等；两边成比例且夹角相等；三边成比例的两个三角形相似。
set.name: Criteria for Similar Triangles

criteria: 能用性质求周长与面积
set.description: 相似三角形对应角相等、对应边成比例，对应高、中线、角平分线之比及周长之比等于相似比，面积之比等于相似比的平方。
set.name: Properties of Similar Triangles

set.description: 旋转前后图形全等，对应点到旋转中心的距离相等，对应点与旋转中心连线所成的角等于旋转角。
